company_at_launch: Sanofi and Regeneron (collaboration); BLA 761055 holder per Drugs@FDA: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals
dosing: subcutaneous; 600 mg initial dose (two 300 mg injections), then 300 mg every other week (adult atopic dermatitis, 2017 label)
first_us_indication: moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis in adults not adequately controlled with topical prescription therapies or when those therapies are not advisable
other_us_indications: asthma, add-on maintenance, age 12+, eosinophilic phenotype or oral corticosteroid-dependent 2018-10-19; atopic dermatitis, age 12-17 2019-03-11; chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps, adults 2019-06-26; atopic dermatitis, age 6-11 2020-05-26; asthma, age 6-11 2021-10-20; eosinophilic esophagitis, age 12+ and 40 kg+ 2022-05-20; atopic dermatitis, age 6 months+ 2022-06-07; prurigo nodularis 2022-09-28; eosinophilic esophagitis, age 1+ and 15 kg+ 2024-01-25; chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps, age 12+ 2024-09-12; COPD with an eosinophilic phenotype 2024-09-27; chronic spontaneous urticaria, age 12+ 2025-04-17; bullous pemphigoid 2025-06-18; allergic fungal rhinosinusitis, age 6+ 2026-02-23; chronic spontaneous urticaria, age 2-11 2026-04-22
notes: Dates from Drugs@FDA (BLA 761055 overview) and the FDA approval letters for supplements S-007, S-012, S-014, S-020, S-031, S-040, S-042, S-044, S-057, S-066, S-064, S-051, S-070, S-075, S-074. No UC or CD approval. Sanofi records global net product sales; Regeneron reports collaboration revenue (its share of profits) and prints Sanofi-recorded sales in USD for information only (Regeneron Q1 2022 earnings release, footnote b). No change in the recording company within the window. Q1 2017 Sanofi release has no Dupixent line; first sales Q2 2017 (EUR 26m, all US).

company_at_launch: Sanofi and Regeneron (collaboration); BLA 761037 approval letter addressed to Sanofi US Services Inc.
dosing: subcutaneous; 200 mg once every two weeks
first_us_indication: adults with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis with inadequate response or intolerance to one or more DMARDs
other_us_indications: polymyalgia rheumatica 2023-02-28; polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, patients weighing 63 kg or more 2024-06-10
notes: Dates from Drugs@FDA (BLA 761037 overview) and approval letters (original, S-013, S-015). No UC or CD approval. Sanofi's Q2 2017 release says Kevzara launched in the US in June 2017. Sanofi's Q4 2019 release says Sanofi and Regeneron announced in December 2019 an intent to restructure the collaboration, with Sanofi expected to gain sole global rights to Kevzara; completion was not confirmed in documents read here. Sanofi records Kevzara net sales throughout the window, so the recording company does not change.

company_at_launch: Roche (US BLA 125276 held by Genentech, Inc., Roche Group; Japan sales by Chugai, consolidated by Roche)
dosing: intravenous infusion every 4 weeks, 4 mg/kg increased to 8 mg/kg based on clinical response (2010 label); subcutaneous 162 mg every other week or every week (BLA 125472, from 2013-10-21)
first_us_indication: adults with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis with inadequate response to one or more TNF antagonist therapies
other_us_indications: systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis, age 2+ 2011-04-15; rheumatoid arthritis broadened to inadequate response to one or more DMARDs 2012-10-11; polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, age 2+ 2013-04-29; subcutaneous formulation for rheumatoid arthritis (BLA 125472) 2013-10-21; giant cell arteritis 2017-05-22; CAR T cell-induced severe or life-threatening cytokine release syndrome, age 2+ 2017-08-30; subcutaneous use in polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis 2018-05-11; subcutaneous use in systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis 2018-09-12; systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease 2021-03-04; COVID-19 in hospitalized adults 2022-12-21
notes: Dates from Drugs@FDA (BLA 125276 and 125472 overviews) and approval letters. No UC or CD approval. Roche's first reported Actemra/RoActemra sales are FY 2009 (Finance Report 2009: global CHF 146m, of which Japan 98m); quarterly figures start Q3 2009 and Q1/Q2 2009 are not printed. Japan sales (Chugai) are included in Roche's figures; Chugai's own pre-2009 sales were not collected. EU approval (RoActemra) January 2009 per Roche Finance Report 2009. First US sales Q1 2010 (CHF 5m). No change in the recording company within the window.
